test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In one hill station train there are three categories of seats. The seats are numbered from 1 to 50 in the first class, 51 to 150 in the second class and 151 to 300 in the third class. Every December, the seat occupancy was 30% in the first class, 50% in the second class and 100% in the third class. If the per seat charges are Rs. 2,000, Rs. 1,000 and Rs. 500 in first class, second class and third class respectively, then the income ratio per category in December month is:
solution:
**Given data:**

Seat numbers in each class,

Occupancy percentage in each class,

Price per seat in each class.

**Concept used:**

Total income = (No. of seats × Occupancy rate × Price per seat)

**Solution:**

⇒ First class income = 50 seats × 30/100 &time
